meta.title: Che Corrado — Creative chef, Zürich
meta.description: Che Corrado is a creative chef trained at El Bulli. Cuina Petita is his mobile kitchen: chef's table, showcase cooking, catering and a food truck in and around Zürich.

hero.intro: Fire, the market and a small kitchen that travels. Chef's table, showcase cooking and catering in and around Zürich.
hero.photo: Paella cooking over an open wood fire

chef.label: The chef
chef.title: Bulliano.
paragraphs: Che Corrado is a creative chef trained at El Bulli, in Cala Montjoi on the Catalan coast.
There, Cuina Petita, the small kitchen, cooked the daily family meal for the Bullianos: a brigade of 75. Everything that came after starts in that room.
Today Che cooks Spanish and Argentine food over charcoal in Switzerland, at private tables, at public events and from the hatch of a food truck.
chef.quote: It is in the kitchen where a chef lives and dies, his true body without which he could not express his full potential.
chef.photo: Cuts of meat on a grill over embers
